     - If the current grid cell (i, j) contains ".", change it to "#" and update the direction index p to (p + 1) % 4 for a clockwise turn.
     - If the current grid cell (i, j) contains "#", change it to "." and update the direction index p to (p - 1 + 4) % 4 for a counterclockwise turn.

fix_code:
H, W, N = map(int, input().split())

grid = []
for i in range(H):
    grid.append(["."] * W)

i = 0
j = 0
p = 0
h = [[0, -1], [1, 0], [0, 1], [-1, 0]]

for k in range(N):
    if grid[i][j] == ".":
        grid[i][j] = "#"
        # 時計まわり
        p = (p + 1) % 4

    elif grid[i][j] == "#":
        grid[i][j] = "."
        # 半時計まわり
        p = (p - 1 + 4) % 4

    # 座標更新
    i = (i + h[p][0] + H) % H
    j = (j + h[p][1] + W) % W

for t in range(H):
    print("".join(grid[t]))
